cluster_reason: These classes form the core lexical-preservation pipeline: LexicalPreservingPrinter coordinates setup, printing, and observer-driven changes; LexicalDifferenceCalculator computes AST-to-text differences used directly by the printer; and NodeText stores the token and child text model manipulated by both. Moving them together preserves their strong internal collaboration and limits package-private visibility changes because the primary implementation dependencies remain within the same new subpackage.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive lexical-preservation core cluster to a dedicated subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move LexicalPreservingPrinter to the shared lexical-preservation core subpackage.
Move LexicalDifferenceCalculator alongside the printer because it calculates the differences directly consumed by the printer.
Move NodeText alongside the printer and difference calculator because it is the shared text representation manipulated throughout the lexical-preservation workflow.
